description: An android-tree pull request adds three strings and a plurals entry, rewords one, and drops the gallery banner's string. One translate session runs per language (de, es, fr, ja). A canned session cannot write files, so the head already holds the translations of the added keys and keeps the old translation of the reworded one, which check counts as not written. Prune deletes the dropped key from every language file, and publish commits the result as a draft patch.
